children: Anthropic has signed a cloud-computing deal worth $35 billion with Lambda, a cloud provider backed by Nvidia
, a source familiar with the matter said on Monday.
The deal will bring online Nvidia capacity to meet growing demand for Anthropic's Claude AI, the source said.
The news was first reported by the Wall Street Journal.
